rule_source: Course staff forum clarifications supplied by the student on 2026-10-23
decision_scores: Unrounded mean test_score across all six folds; higher is better
dataset_rule: At least 3 of 5 learners satisfy Joint Signal and at least 3 of 5 satisfy TAR Gain, counted independently; learners may differ
per_learner_passes_column: Diagnostic that both criteria hold for that learner; not the dataset acceptance count
interpretation_note: TabM joint gain is positive but negligible (about 0.000111 AUROC). Numerical acceptance is not evidence of statistical significance or large practical gains.
